name: The Forsaken
source: You have lived your whole life in the mountains among the Forsaken to learn about your unique powers in peace , away from everything and everyone. You felt at home there, content with your quest for knowledge and wisdom, living among your peers. However, one year something shifted. Tensions started growing, people changed and you felt something ominous was settling in.  After years of feeling more and more oppressed, you realised you didn't feel at home anymore. One night you decide to escape, to see what's beyond these mountains. But your freedom will be short lived, as you realise you can't really flee from who you are.
translation: 你一生都生活在被遗忘者的山里，远离一切和所有人，平静地了解你独特的力量。你在那里感到宾至如归，满足于你对知识和智慧的追求，生活在你的同龄人中间。然而，一年后事情发生了变化。紧张局势开始加剧，人们发生了变化，你感觉有一些不祥的事情正在发生。在多年来感到越来越压抑之后，你意识到你不再有宾至如归的感觉了。一天晚上，你决定逃离，去看看这些山脉之外有什么。但你的自由将是短暂的，因为你意识到你无法真正逃离自己。
